_what_this_is: PRE-REGISTERED FORWARD TRIAL of the regime-join direction call, opened 2026-09-12 after the operator asked the right question: 'if everything is a null we will never put anything into trial will we'. It exists because the bar this desk had been applying - t>2 and a CI excluding zero - is UNACHIEVABLE BY CONSTRUCTION on one year of one instrument (min detectable edge 2.84-23.57pt against a 1.05-1.50pt ceiling). A bar nothing can pass is not a standard, it is a way of never deciding.
registered_by: operator: 'are you being too harsh on everything? if everything is a null we will never put anything into trial will we'
hypothesis: Entering in the direction of an ESTABLISHED regime (not a break) and holding to a clock carries a small positive directional edge. Measured gross: MNQ/NQ +0.15 to +0.34pt over 10.5 years and 33,000 trades; MGC +0.15 to +0.28pt over 13 months. Positive in 12 of 12 NQ cells and every MGC cell against a sign-flip control at identical bars.
why_it_is_a_TRIAL_and_not_a_LIVE_promoti: It has never once cleared t=2, and on MNQ costs it is a quarter of the fee. It is trialled because the SIGN is consistent across 12 cells, two instruments and eleven years, and because the only reason it cannot be proven is a sample size this desk cannot buy at MNQ's event rate. Forward evidence is the only thing that settles it, and forward evidence costs nothing to collect.
instrument: MGC (gold) — chosen because its friction is 0.45pt against MNQ's 1.25, so the SAME measured edge is 16-62% of cost instead of 12-27%, and the 120m cells are the only net-positive cells this study has produced on any instrument.

rule_frozen.bars: 15-minute, front month by session volume — never backfill_1min.parquet (22.46% dying contract)
rule_frozen.states: 4-state diagonal-covariance GMM, features z-scored on the fit window, fitted ONCE on 2025-07-27..2026-04-30 and NEVER refitted
rule_frozen.guard: d8_gap between BULLISH and BEARISH must exceed 0.5 ATR or the session is skipped and logged as DEGENERATE — the defect that made 8 of 72 fitted models trade a direction label carrying no direction
rule_frozen.entry: the open of the next bar after a clean transition INTO a directional state (the state absent in the prior 2 bars)
rule_frozen.hold: 120 minutes, no target, no stop, flat by 20:40Z regardless
rule_frozen.size: 1 lot — the paper engine fabricates a 0.1% adverse fill on every lot beyond the first
rule_frozen.fees: MGC $4.50 per round trip = 0.45pt at $10/point. The 0.30pt spread is crossed ONCE.

controls_logged_every_session.SIGN_FLIP: the identical entries at the identical bars with the direction reversed — the control that cannot move the entry population, after the 5-way label permutation was retired for swinging entry counts +33%
controls_logged_every_session.ALWAYS_LONG: the same bars, always long — the drift baseline
controls_logged_every_session.RANDOM_TIME: the same COUNT of entries at random times in the same sessions, 100 draws averaged — never one draw, which has a +-4.2pt standard error and once invented a bull drift that did not exist

THE_BAR_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THIS_ONE.primary: mean gross per trade > the SIGN_FLIP control's mean, with the difference's day-clustered 95% bootstrap CI excluding zero, at 200 trades
THE_BAR_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THIS_ONE.secondary: net of the 0.45pt fee, the mean is positive
THE_BAR_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THIS_ONE.explicitly_NOT_required: t >= 2 on the trade sample. That threshold needs ~4,400 to 27,000 trades at this effect size and is unreachable inside a year; requiring it is how a desk books eleven months of nulls and promotes nothing.
THE_BAR_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THIS_ONE.CONFIRMED: primary AND secondary -> propose a shadow slot, still not live money
THE_BAR_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THIS_ONE.REFUTED: the sign-flip control matches or beats it at 200 trades
THE_BAR_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THIS_ONE.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 200 trades by 2026-12-31 — report as inconclusive, never as either verdict

rules_of_engagement: DO NOT refit the GMM. The fit window is closed and the parameters are frozen.
DO NOT tune the 120-minute hold, the state count, or the z-scoring. A moved knob restarts the count at zero.
DO NOT read the interim and act on it. n<200 is not evidence by construction.
The 2015-2026 measurement window is where the effect was FOUND. Its P&L is NOT a result.
Read-only. This places no orders and touches no service.
